mapper.update: DELETE dc FROM dept_closure dc INNER JOIN dept_closure sub ON sub.descendant_id = dc.descendant_id WHERE sub.ancestor_id = #{deptId}

DELETE stale FROM dept_closure stale INNER JOIN dept_closure sub ON sub.descendant_id = stale.descendant_id LEFT JOIN dept_closure keep ON keep.ancestor_id = sub.ancestor_id AND keep.descendant_id = stale.ancestor_id WHERE sub.ancestor_id = #{deptId} AND keep.ancestor_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dept_closure (ancestor_id, descendant_id, depth) SELECT super_chain.ancestor_id, sub.descendant_id, super_chain.depth + sub.depth + 1 FROM dept_closure sub INNER JOIN dept_closure super_chain ON super_chain.descendant_id = #{newParentId} WHERE #{newParentId} > 0 AND sub.ancestor_id = #{deptId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.parent_id > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dept_closure c WHERE c.descendant_id = d.id AND c.ancestor_id = d.parent_id AND c.depth = 1)

SELECT d.id, d.dept_name, d.parent_id FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.parent_id > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dept_closure c WHERE c.descendant_id = d.id AND c.ancestor_id = d.parent_id AND c.depth = 1) ORDER BY d.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_dept child JOIN (SELECT descendant_id, COUNT(*) AS closure_cnt FROM dept_closure GROUP BY descendant_id) child_cnt ON child_cnt.descendant_id = child.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT descendant_id, COUNT(*) AS closure_cnt FROM dept_closure GROUP BY descendant_id) parent_cnt ON parent_cnt.descendant_id = child.parent_id WHERE child.parent_id > 0 AND child_cnt.closure_cnt <> (COALESCE(parent_cnt.closure_cnt, 0) + 1)

SELECT child.id, child.dept_name, child.parent_id, child_cnt.closure_cnt AS child_closure_cnt, parent_cnt.closure_cnt AS parent_closure_cnt, (COALESCE(parent_cnt.closure_cnt, 0) + 1) AS expected_child_cnt FROM sys_dept child JOIN (SELECT descendant_id, COUNT(*) AS closure_cnt FROM dept_closure GROUP BY descendant_id) child_cnt ON child_cnt.descendant_id = child.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT descendant_id, COUNT(*) AS closure_cnt FROM dept_closure GROUP BY descendant_id) parent_cnt ON parent_cnt.descendant_id = child.parent_id WHERE child.parent_id > 0 AND child_cnt.closure_cnt <> (COALESCE(parent_cnt.closure_cnt, 0) + 1) ORDER BY child.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT SUM(IF(cnt = 0, 1, 0)) AS zero_closure, SUM(IF(cnt = 1, 1, 0)) AS only_self, SUM(IF(cnt > 1, 1, 0)) AS has_ancestors, COUNT(*) AS total FROM (SELECT d.id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dept_closure c WHERE c.descendant_id = d.id) AS cnt FROM sys_dept d) x
